verdict.rationale: Letta is an agent platform (Agent SDK, App Server, cloud-hosted agents), not only a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server. A Letta team member points users to a community-built MCP server, which is explicitly not official. The SDK's MCP support is client-side tool consumption and does not count here. Letta exposes agents through ACP and an OpenAI-compatible API, which are not MCP.
